keep_all_slabs_filter: use the keep_all_slabs filter to pass through all adsorbate slab configurations without filtering
filter_by_miller_indices: use keep_slabs_with_miller_indices to filter adsorbate slabs by a list of allowed Miller index tuples
prompt_interactive_slab_selection: use prompt_for_slabs_to_keep to present an interactive checkbox prompt for users to select slabs to relax
sort_adslabs_by_metadata: use the _sort_key method to generate sort keys from Miller indices, shift, and top/bottom surface labels
refactor_filter_classes: refactor the filter classes to support additional slab metadata fields beyond Miller indices and shift
